title: Bota Singh's Martyrdom and the Opening of Sukha Singh's Story

blocks.text: The page closes the encounter by honoring the two Singhs for fighting eye to eye until martyrdom. Their deaths are treated as the sealing proof of a public challenge that neither the Nawab nor his troops could morally answer except by overwhelming force.

The narrator then deliberately pivots away from mourning and into exemplarity. Now hear the story of Sukha Singh, whose life is introduced as the next demonstration of the same Khalsa daring in a new setting.
This transition turns one martyr episode into the threshold of another. Heroic memory is not left behind; it becomes the atmosphere in which Sukha Singh's character first appears.
